thread:
maria: Pushed RBAC mapping for deployers to staging. Immediately started seeing CI SAST failures across ~150 open PRs. Anyone else?
alex: Yep, lots of noise. Many findings flagged as 'auth bypass' in generated protobuf files. Smells like rule mismatch after we moved generated code paths. /cc @jin
jin: Looking at scanner logs now. Also seeing KMS decrypt failures around the same deployment window. Scanner couldn't decrypt artifact metadata to attach evidence: `kms.decrypt: AccessDenied` in the GH action logs.
```
2026-03-23T11:58:12Z scanner[sha]: ERROR kms.decrypt: AccessDenied principal=svc-ci-scanner
```
sec-bot: Alert: Keystore audit gap detected for principal svc-ci-scanner at 2026-03-23T11:59:00Z. Recommend `keystore:check` and audit-log export.
casey: I removed an old group binding earlier to tidy up perms; I think that revoked `roles/keystore.decrypt` for the scanner.
maria: Oof. I only intended to update deployer mappings, not scanner. Rolling back the change for scanner now and re-running the pipeline.
alex: While rollback runs, please add a temporary SAST suppression rule for generated/*proto* so we don't spam owners. Also capture keystore audit logs + GH action traces for compliance — we need evidence for the change and rollback.
jin: After rollback the KMS calls succeed and the scanner uploaded evidence artifacts. Scanner report shows many of the auth bypass hits were on `gen/*.pb.go` — we'll keep suppression for 48h. DAST still flapping on login in staging: headless chrome gets 401 intermittently during auth test run.
```
curl -X POST https://staging.redwood.ai/_login -d '{"username":"bot","password":"***"}' -i
HTTP/1.1 401 Unauthorized
```
casey: DAST failure likely caused by SameSite cookie attribute change from the infra tweak earlier this week. I'll revert the cookie setting in staging config and re-run the DAST suite.
maria: Plan recap: (1) PR to re-add keystore decrypt role for svc-ci-scanner with temporary exception audit note (2) SAST suppression rule for generated protobuf outputs for 48 hours (3) revert SameSite cookie flag in staging to stabilize DAST + monitor. I'll open an incident doc and tag legal/compliance for the audit bundle. :thumbsup:
